title: marrubium globosum subsp. libanoticum
intro: Marrubium globosum subsp. libanoticum, commonly known as Lebanese horehound, is a subspecies of the Marrubium globosum plant, belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, respiratory problems, and inflammation, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Marrubium globosum subsp. libanoticum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant are responsible for its therapeutic effects, which make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine for treating various health conditions.
